description:
Hi,

Greetings

Hope you are doing great!

I would like to update you on an urgent open position with our esteemed client. Please go through the Job Description. Send me your updated resume and expected rate for the below position

 Role: Technology Analyst – C#, .Net
Duration: Full Time
Location: Los Angeles, CA

Qualifications
Basic
 
•Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required. Will also consider one year of relevant work experience in lieu of every year of education
•At least 2 years of experience with IT

 Preferred 
• At least 2+ years of experience in .NET development using below frameworks and technologies:
•Visual studio, MS .NET 3.5/4.0/4.5, C#, WPF, PRISM, UNITY, XML, GIT and SQL SERVER 2008
•Design patterns like MVVM, GoF
•Infragistics or any other third party control for WPF
• Working Knowledge of different messaging frameworks like RV, JMS, TIBCO, WCF and IBM MQ
• Working Knowledge of SSH.Net or similar .Net – Unix interaction
• Working Knowledge of UNIX commands
• Good hands-on Knowledge of Web Services (Rest/Soap)
• Strong hold on SQL/Database concepts.
• Experience with source control, build and deployment tools such as Jenkins, Maven, Git, TeamCity
• At least 2 years of experience in any one agile methodology
• Strong communication, articulation skills also good exposure w.r.t client communication.
• Ability to work in team environment and client interfacing skills.
• Strong analytical skills
• Experience and desire to work in a Global delivery environment



 •Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required. Will also consider one year of relevant work experience in lieu of every year of education


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
